S.FORM: qwalax hya' ga hway bniq babaw rhzyal na yaba' utux kayal, mwah prkyas squ qqhuniq, kk'man, kwara pinbahu, ru miq qsya' ita', nanu yasa qu maki' nniqun ta' ru nnbun ta', thuzyay ta' minblaq mqyanux ru mlahang kinbahan. kinbkesan 'tayal hiya' ga skita' naha squ kinkrahu' na qwalax ru kya qu pinspngan naha, ru ini' ptnaq sinllwan naha lalu' na qwalax,smsmun ga, ki'a spayat qu lalu' nya. smn'iyal: 下大雨 krahu' ru khmay qwalax nya' mshayhway: 下小雨 cikuy ru thayhway qwalax nya' smyawkay: 絲絲細雨 zkhi' ru lhmiq qwalax nya', yan yawkay === smgiqu': 毛毛雨 yan giqu' kincipuq ru lhbaw qwalax nya' ===
S.PHON: qwalax ħjaʔ ɣa ħwaj βniq βaβaw rħzjal na jaβaʔ utux kajal mwaħ prkja[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]qu qqħuniq kkʔman kwara pinβaħu ru miq q[s|ɕ]jaʔ itaʔ nanu ja[s|ɕ]a qu makiʔ nniqun taʔ ru nnβun taʔ tħuzjaj taʔ minβlaq mqjanux ru mlaħaŋ kinβaħan kinβke[s|ɕ]an ʔtajal ħijaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]kitaʔ naħa [s|ɕ]qu kinkraħuʔ na qwalax ru kja qu pin[s|ɕ]pŋan naħa ru iniʔ ptnaq [s|ɕ]inllwan naħa laluʔ na qwalax[s|ɕ]m[s|ɕ]mun ɣa kiʔa [s|ɕ]pajat qu laluʔ nja [s|ɕ]mnʔijal *** kraħuʔ ru kħmaj qwalax njaʔ m[s|ɕ]ħajħwaj *** [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj ru tħajħwaj qwalax njaʔ [s|ɕ]mjawkaj **** zkħiʔ ru lħmiq qwalax njaʔ jan jawkaj [s|ɕ]mɣiquʔ *** jan ɣiquʔ kin[ʦ|ʨ]ipuq ru lħβaw qwalax njaʔ
